content:
alice_support: FYI — acme-inc (trial) reports credits not decrementing. They ran text-generation and embeddings, ~5k tokens according to client, but console still shows 1000 trial credits remaining. Customer worried they'll be billed once trial ends. :worried:

jamie_engineer: Can you drop the example request + request_id and the org_id they used? Also which model and endpoint?

alice_support: Sent via DM but pasting here for visibility. Request id: req_0a7f3b, org: org-acme-123, curl they used:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-test-ACME" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-large-v1","input":"summarize...","max_tokens":256}'
```
Response headers (as pasted by customer):
```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
X-Request-Id: req_0a7f3b
X-Credits-Remaining: 1000
X-Credits-Deducted: 0
Content-Type: application/json
```
They also attached a screenshot of the console usage graph showing token spikes at the same timestamps.

jamie_engineer: Thanks. Quick check done: the request shows served by routing node r-32 in region-us-east. I don't see consumption events in the billing stream for req_0a7f3b. Two possibilities: (1) request was routed to a non-metered fallback (rare), or (2) consumption was recorded but tagged to a different org id. I'll flag infra to check routing.

kevin_infra: Looking at the routing logs: req_0a7f3b indeed hit a fallback replica group labeled "compat-readonly" that has metrics tagging disabled. That group was spun up in a short window during a rolling update for serving. There's a recent change in the autoscaler that didn't copy the billing tag config.

sam_billing: If the replica group doesn't emit consumption events, the billing pipeline won't decrement trial credits. We need to correct customer ledger and prevent recurrence.

credits-bot: Automatic ledger check: org-acme-123 has promo grant "TRIAL-2024-ACME" (1000 credits) applied 1711936000. Current ledger balance: 1000 (trial_credits). Consumption events found (0). Pending manual adjustment recommended.

alice_support: Confirmed customer did not get any credit deduction. Apologized and told them we're troubleshooting and will credit usage if appropriate.

kevin_infra: Action plan: (1) Run a backfill job to reconcile any requests served by replica groups missing tags in the window 1712098800-1712103000 and emit synthetic consumption events with original request_id and token counts; (2) patch autoscaler to copy billing tags on new replica groups; (3) add an alert when any serving node reports zero billing tag headers. I'll own 2 & 3, Jamie can own backfill.

jamie_engineer: I'll start backfill job now. Small note: need to verify token accounting from runtime logs (kv-cache affects token counts). If we can't reconstruct exact token count, we should apply conservative deduction (use client reported tokens) and add audit entry.

sam_billing: Once backfill produces events, I'll run a ledger fix to decrement trial_credits and post an entry in billing history. I'll also issue a goodwill credit equal to the usage if there's any ambiguity.

alice_support: I'll relay timeline to acme-inc: ETA ~2 business hours for backfill + ledger fix, then confirmation.

kevin_infra: Patch PR open: https://git.internal.redwood/p/r/autoscaler-billing-tags Fix will be hotfixed to prod in next deploy window.

jamie_engineer: Backfill finished. Reconciled 12 requests in window; used client-reported token counts where runtime reconstruction ambiguous. Emitted synthetic consumption events referencing original req ids.

sam_billing: Applied ledger decrements for org-acme-123: -5,200 tokens from trial_credits, new balance: 0. Audit ref: BILL-AUDIT-171210. Also applied goodwill credit 5,200 tokens on promo bucket for 30 days. Notified finance.

alice_support: Customer updated: they see balance 0 and appreciate the goodwill credit. They asked for a follow-up summary for their records.

kevin_infra: Follow-up: root cause = autoscaler not copying billing tag config to ephemeral replica groups during a narrow rolling window. Patch merged and hotfixed. Alert added.

alice_support: Closing loop with customer and logging postmortem in #postmortems. Thanks all. :slightly_smiling_face:
